Unbypass (CTRL-B) the ReferenceLatent nodes to give ref images.

If you want to add more reference images, you can add multiple reference images by following the pattern.

If you don't want any reference image, just select all ReferenceLatent nodes and then use CTRL-B to bypass them, turning the workflow into a Text to Image workflow.

超高细节，8K分辨率，色彩精准，构图大胆前卫，具有强烈的视觉冲击力和艺术感。大师级摄影，电影级质感。
